name: Trent Ltd
description: Trent Ltd is the retail powerhouse of the Tata Group and one of India's fastest growing retail enterprises. Operating flagship value-fashion format Zudio, department store chain Westside, footwear chain Utsa, and supermarket chain Star Bazaar (in joint venture with Tesco), Trent has pioneered ultra-fast inventory turnaround and 100% private-label retailing.

company_profile.summary: Trent Ltd is the retail powerhouse of the Tata Group and one of India's fastest growing retail enterprises. Operating flagship value-fashion format Zudio, department store chain Westside, footwear chain Utsa, and supermarket chain Star Bazaar (in joint venture with Tesco), Trent has pioneered ultra-fast inventory turnaround and 100% private-label retailing.

revenue_breakup.desc: Ultra-affordable, trend-led apparel and cosmetics priced strictly under ₹999.
Contemporary private-label apparel, footwear, accessories, and home décor.
Hypermarket food, fresh groceries, Misbu beauty accessories, and Samoh occasion-wear.

moats_and_strengths: Zudio has created India's most successful retail playbook with industry-leading store-level ROCE (>40%).
100% exclusive private-label portfolio giving Trent gross margin control of ~45% without brand licensing fees.
Fast-fashion supply chain capable of conceptualizing, manufacturing, and putting designs on racks in under 15 days.
Zero promotional discounting at Westside and Zudio reflecting extraordinary full-price consumer sell-through.
company_profile.order_book_or_capacity: Store Count: 600+ Zudio stores • 240+ Westside stores • Store addition pace: 200+ new Zudio stores annually

bullish_triggers: Aggressive store expansion into Tier-3 and Tier-4 cities where organized fashion penetration remains below 15%.
Monetization of Zudio Beauty and standalone cosmetics retail counters.
International pilot store launches in neighboring South Asian and Middle Eastern diaspora markets.
bearish_risks: Cannibalization between adjacent Zudio stores in mature metropolitan clusters.
Competition from value-fashion formats launched by Reliance Retail (Yousta) and Aditya Birla Fashion (Style Up).

liquidation_safety.pledge_deadline: 9:00 PM on T-day (Mandatory CDSL/NSDL OTP authorization)
